title: Fix three bugs in a Python LRU cache
description: Fix bugs in LRUCache using OrderedDict: get() doesn't mark key as recently used, put() evicts MRU instead of LRU, size() has off-by-one.

files.tests/test_lru_cache.py:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from src.lru_cache import LRUCache


def test_basic_evict():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts key 1
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == 2
    assert cache.get(3) == 3


def test_lru_order():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.get(1)   # mark 1 as recently used
    cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts 2 (LRU)
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    assert cache.get(3) == 3


def test_size():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    cache.put('a', 1)
    cache.put('b', 2)
    cache.put('c', 3)
    assert cache.size() == 3

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lru_cache.py:
1. get: add `self._cache.move_to_end(key)` before the return to mark as recently used
2. put: change `popitem(last=True)` to `popitem(last=False)` to evict the least-recently-used (front)
3. size: return `len(self._cache)` not `len(self._cache) + 1`
All 3 tests must pass.
